Teknoppy works as an ecommerce development company Dubai brands choose for fixed quotes, clear timelines and one senior project lead, with ecommerce website development Dubai and Abu Dhabi projects delivered remotely.

sections.h2: Ecommerce Stores We Build for UAE Brands

items.title: Shopify Development
items.text: Shopify development Dubai brands choose is ideal for fast launches, easy daily management and reliable hosting. We set up a Shopify store with AED checkout, Arabic and English content, local payment apps and courier integrations.

items.title: WooCommerce Development
items.text: WooCommerce development UAE suits brands that already use WordPress or need flexible content and lower monthly platform fees. We build secure, fast WooCommerce stores with the same local payments and VAT setup.

items.title: Custom Stores
items.text: For complex catalogues, custom pricing or integrations with ERP and warehouse systems, we build custom stores. Our B2B ecommerce website development UAE projects add trade pricing, bulk ordering, credit terms and account-based catalogues.

sections.intro: Our online store development UAE work covers new launches, rebuilds and platform moves. Most projects fall into one of four types.

sections.h2: Shopify, WooCommerce or Custom: Which Fits Your Store?

paragraphs.text: Most UAE fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands choose Shopify. Brands with heavy content or existing WordPress sites often prefer WooCommerce. We recommend the option that fits your products, team and budget, not the one that is easiest for us.

sections.h2: Payments: Cards, Tabby, Tamara and Cash on Delivery
sections.intro: UAE shoppers expect several ways to pay. Every store we build supports:

items.html: Cards and wallets: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay through a UAE-supported payment gateway.
Buy now, pay later: an ecommerce website with Tabby and Tamara lets shoppers split payments, which often lifts average order values.
Cash on delivery: an online store with cash on delivery UAE customers trust, with order limits and confirmation messages to reduce failed deliveries.

outro.text: We test every payment method before launch, including refunds and partial refunds. This is how we build Shopify stores with AED checkout, Tabby and Tamara that convert.

items.title: VAT
items.html: The UAE charges 5% VAT on most goods. We set up VAT-inclusive prices, VAT lines at checkout and an ecommerce website with UAE VAT invoices that show your Tax Registration Number. See the Federal Tax Authority for current rules, and ask your accountant to confirm your setup.

items.title: Shipping
items.text: We connect your store to couriers such as Aramex, Emirates Post or same-day local delivery partners, with delivery zones and fees by emirate. Clear delivery times on product pages reduce customer questions, and automatic tracking messages by email or WhatsApp keep buyers informed after checkout.

items.title: Returns
items.text: We add a simple returns page, return request forms and clear policies, because uncertainty about returns is a common reason UAE shoppers leave without buying.

paragraphs.text: Many UAE stores sell to both Arabic- and English-speaking customers. We build bilingual stores with right-to-left Arabic layouts, mirrored menus and filters, Arabic product titles and a simple language switcher. Product data stays in sync, so prices, stock and offers always match in both languages. Where your customers are mostly expatriates, we can launch in English first and add Arabic later without rebuilding.

sections.h2: Speed and SEO for Online Stores

paragraphs.html: Most UAE shoppers browse on mobile, so slow stores lose sales. We build for good Core Web Vitals: compressed images, fast themes, lazy loading and minimal apps. Every store also gets clean URLs, Product and Offer schema, collection page content and a sitemap, so Google can understand your catalogue from launch. For ongoing rankings, our SEO company in Dubai team can take over after launch.

items.title: Ecommerce Website for Dubai Fashion Brands
items.text: An ecommerce website for Dubai fashion brands needs strong visuals, size guides, lookbooks, Instagram integration and easy exchanges. We also add modest-fashion and occasion filters where they help shoppers find the right piece faster.

items.title: Ecommerce Website for UAE Electronics Stores
items.text: An ecommerce website for UAE electronics stores needs detailed specifications, comparison tables, warranty information and fast search across large catalogues, with stock levels synced from your inventory system.

items.title: Beauty, Home and Food
items.text: We also build stores for beauty, furniture, mattresses, home goods and specialty food brands, with subscriptions, bundles, gift wrapping and seasonal campaigns for Ramadan, Eid, White Friday and Dubai Shopping Festival.

Also see our Web Design Company for UAE Businesses, Ecommerce Development, Shopify and WooCommerce pages.

items.q: Shopify or WooCommerce for a UAE store?
items.a: Shopify suits most new UAE brands because it is fast to launch and easy to manage. WooCommerce suits brands already on WordPress or those that want more control. We compare both for your products and budget before recommending one.

items.q: Can you add Tabby or Tamara?
items.a: Yes. We connect Tabby, Tamara or both through their official apps or plugins, test the full checkout and show instalment messages on product pages.

items.q: How long does a store take to build?
items.a: Most stores take six to ten weeks, depending on products, design and integrations. Custom and B2B stores can take up to 16 weeks.

items.q: Can you move our store from another platform?
items.a: Yes. As an ecommerce website development company UAE brands trust with migrations, we move products, customers, orders and URLs, and set up redirects so you keep your existing traffic.

items.q: Do we own the store and its data?
items.a: Yes. Your store, domain, products, customer data and design files belong to you. On Shopify, the store is set up under your own account; on WooCommerce or custom builds, you receive full admin access and the code.
